name: charkle-web
description: Self-hosted full-stack TypeScript visual reference library & rapid moodboard studio

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @charkle/shared && (trap 'kill 0' EXIT; npm run dev -w @charkle/server & npm run dev -w @charkle/client & wait)
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @charkle/shared && npm run dev -w @charkle/server
scripts.dev:client: npm run build -w @charkle/shared && npm run dev -w @charkle/client
scripts.build: npm run build -w @charkle/shared && npm run build -w @charkle/server && npm run build -w @charkle/client
scripts.test: npm run build -w @charkle/shared && npm run build -w @charkle/server && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @charkle/shared && npm run build -w @charkle/server && npm run typecheck -w @charkle/shared && npm run typecheck -w @charkle/server && npm run typecheck -w @charkle/client && npm run typecheck -w @charkle/worker
scripts.cf:typecheck: npm run build -w @charkle/shared && npm run build -w @charkle/server && npm run typecheck -w @charkle/worker
scripts.cf:dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w @charkle/worker
scripts.cf:dry-run: npm run build && npm run dry-run -w @charkle/worker
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w @charkle/worker
